blockers.requires: Either (a) fmontesi fixes HML's LogicalEquivalence instantiation upstream in #607 (recommended -- this blocks #607's own CI independent of #662), or (b) a narrowly-scoped follow-up task to migrate HML/LogicalEquivalence.lean to the new 4-arg HasLogicalEquivalence API (mirroring what #607 already did correctly for Modal/LogicalEquivalence.lean and CLL). Task 477 deliberately did NOT touch this file since it is outside the plan's declared Non-Goals scope and is PR #607's own defect, not #662's.
